note: Default values are experimental starting points for the dissertation, not claimed optima.

rationale.latency_packet_size: ICMP payload size in bytes (OS ping -l/-s). 32 B matches common OS defaults. Not claimed optimal; used so tests are repeatable.
rationale.latency_packet_count: Number of probe packets. More samples improve min/max/median stability but lengthen the test.
rationale.latency_timeout: Per-probe timeout in seconds so a lost packet does not stall the phase.
rationale.download_duration: Measurement window in seconds after warm-up. Duration-based throughput is comparable across line rates.
rationale.upload_duration: Same idea for uplink. Independent of download so asymmetric links can be studied.
rationale.download_connections: Parallel HTTP GET streams. Default 1 avoids confounding multi-flow aggregation; increase only as an experiment.
rationale.upload_connections: Parallel HTTP POST streams. Default 1 for the same reason.
rationale.warmup_duration: Seconds discarded at the start so TCP slow-start is less dominant in the average.
rationale.measurement_interval: How often live Mbps is sampled for SSE and peak detection.
rationale.timeout: Socket/HTTP timeout for a single transfer attempt.
rationale.retry_count: Extra attempts after a failed connection. Failures are recorded, not silently dropped.
